tooltip_fire_bomb: Instantly capture 2 small squares next to your land. Available from Turn 0.
tooltip_bombardment: Capture 8 small squares at once with a bombardment. Available from Turn 10.
tooltip_soldier_spell: Bring 15 reinforcement soldiers to one of your squares. Available from Turn 12.
tooltip_mega_bomba: Capture 25 small squares at once with the Super Blast. Available from Turn 45.
error_ability_locked: This ability is not yet unlocked.
error_cooldown_active: This ability is unavailable for {turns} more turns.
shop_read_only: View only -- it is not your turn.
shop_empty: No items available for purchase right now.
tutorial_step_map: This map is Africa. The continent is made of hundreds of small squares. You are the blue squares in the north-west; the bots start at the other ends of Africa. Pinch to zoom and drag to move.
tutorial_step_territory: Select one of your squares, then tap a square next to it to attack or move soldiers. Tap your selected square again to deploy reserve soldiers.
tutorial_step_resources: At the end of each turn you earn 80 diamonds and an extra soldier for every 12 squares you own. Capture a diamond mine for 250 more diamonds, or a gold mine (the gold bars) for 150.
tutorial_step_abilities: Cards capture squares: Fire Bomb 2, Bombardment 8, Super Blast 25. The Soldier Spell brings soldiers.
tutorial_step_shop: Spend diamonds at the Weapon Shop to buy extra cards.
tutorial_step_end_turn: When you are ready, press End Turn; the bots play next.
tutorial_step_victory: Wipe every bot off the map, or conquer all of Africa, to win.
hint_select_territory: Tap a square on the map to view its info.
hint_attack: Select your square, then tap a neighbouring square to attack or move soldiers. Tap your square again to deploy reserve soldiers.
ability_select_target: {ability}: Tap a square with an orange frame.
error_ability_not_ready: This ability is not ready yet.
error_invalid_target: This card cannot be used there. Pick a square next to your land.
cannot_deploy: No soldiers to deploy, or the base is full.
shop_item_desc: Gives one extra use of the ability, ignoring its cooldown.
difficulty_title: How strong should the bots be?
difficulty_very_easy_desc: The bots play slowly and timidly.
difficulty_medium_desc: The bots try to grab land.
difficulty_hard_desc: The bots attack bases and mines and use every card.
